chunks: From him, from Al-Muqani'i, from Bakkar ibn Ahmad, from Al-Hasan ibn Al-Husayn, from Talid, from Abu Al-Jahhaf, from Khalid ibn Abd al-Malik, from Matar Al-Warraq, from Al-Naji (meaning Abu Al-Siddiq), from Abu Sa'id, who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Give glad tidings of the Mahdi,' and he repeated this thrice. 'He will emerge when there is discord among the people and a severe earthquake. He will fill the earth with equity and justice, just as it was filled with oppression and tyranny. He will fill the hearts of his servants with worship, and his justice will encompass them.'

key_terms.المَهْدِي: The Guided One, referring to the twelfth Imam

ai.seo_question: What are the signs and characteristics of Imam Mahdi's emergence according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba*, this hadith from Abu Sa'id underscores the Prophet's triple emphasis on the Mahdi's emergence during an era of profound political and natural turmoil. It highlights the eschatological transformation where global injustice is replaced by divine equity, a theme deeply rooted in Shia tradition as the culmination of prophetic history. The promise of filling hearts with devotion complements the external establishment of justice, reflecting the holistic nature of the Mahdi's rule.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 137 - It is narrated from Maqanai from Bakkar bin Ahmad from Hasan bin Husain from Talid from Abu Jahaf [from Khalid bin Abdul Malik from Matar Warraq from Naji, that is Abu Siddiq from Abu Saeed Khudri] that he said:

The Messenger of Allah (s) said: ‘Glad tidings to you, by the presence of Mahdi,’ and he repeated this statement thrice. ‘When he stages an uprising, people would be involved in discord and instability. He would fill the earth with justice and equity just as it would be fraught with injustice and oppression; and he would make people inclined to worship and his justice would encompass them.
